cohort: The study included 68 GDM pregnant women (56 diet-controlled, 12 insulin-treated) and 42 healthy pregnant women.
finding: Expression levels of visfatin and human fetuin A were significantly higher in GDM pregnant women and were associated with an increased incidence of adverse outcomes.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken from maternal and umbilical cord serum, and placental tissue, presumably during pregnancy and at birth.
